currencies.

counts as spending.
FIX A BALANCE IN SECONDS

LOANS AND LENDINGS

charge, or an extra on top), reminders and write-offs. See your net worth on the Assets and Liabilities tabs.
LOOK BACK

week, month or year.
REMINDERS AND A WIDGET

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS

IN YOUR LANGUAGE

fdroid:com.gymmane.app.description:
GymMane is a strength log built for the gym floor, not for a dashboard. Tap the muscles you want to train on an interactive body map, log reps and weight set by set, rest with an alarm that actually gets your attention, and read progress that comes from your own sets. 🏋️ TRAINING
• Interactive body map, front and back — tap what you want to train
• A session picked for you, then edited set by set
• Reps, weight and a rest timer with your own alarm sound
• Set types — warm-up, working, drop set, to failure — and the plates per side worked out while you load the bar
• A live session survives a reboot — carry on where you left off
• Routines you can group, reorder and schedule per weekday, several a day if you like
• Warm-up and cardio sessions, and a next step when an exercise gets easy
• Places — say what kit you have at home, at the gym or in the park and you only get offered what you can actually do there
📊 PROGRESS
• Volume, streak, weekly goal ring and personal records, all from your own sets
• GitHub-style activity heatmap with per-day detail
• Strength curves with estimated 1RM per exercise
• Muscle split across the last 30 days
• Progress photo timeline — front, side and back, with a before-and-after view and a reminder when the next one is due
• Rather not photograph yourself? The same timeline drawn as a muscle map, built from your own sets
• Bodyweight and ten body measurements, each with its own history and curve
• A share card you can post — streak, muscles worked or your before/after
📚 EXERCISES & TOOLS
• 500+ exercises with animations and step-by-step instructions
• Search, filters by muscle, equipment and level, favourites and your own exercises
• Swap the art of any exercise for your own photo, GIF or video
• A training journal on a calendar — notes tagged as note, plan, win or niggle, with photos and video
• Twelve calculators: 1RM, plates, BMI, calories & macros, body fat, warm-up, RPE load, strength level, Wilks, FFMI, protein and water

💾 YOUR DATA

The permissions it does ask for, and why: notifications and exact alarms for the rest timer, vibration so the alarm buzzes and wake lock so it fires with the screen off.

It monitors signals from Bluetooth devices, Wi-Fi access points, cellular towers, and GNSS satellites.
Spectre also features a growing set of pentesting tools, constrained by Android's security model.
Features:
• RF exposure - total received power from cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth as one live dBm reading
• Cellular - serving and neighbor cells on 5G, 4G, 3G, and 2G, across both SIMs
• Wi-Fi - 2.4, 5, and 6 GHz access points, with security analysis and 802.11mc FTM ranging
• Bluetooth LE - advertising devices with decoded manufacturer data, including iBeacons
• GNSS - multi-constellation, dual-frequency satellite tracking with live sky geometry
• Local network scan - discover hosts, open ports, and running services on your network
• GATT inspector - connect to a BLE device to read, decode, and write its characteristics
• iBeacon broadcast - advertise your phone as a configurable iBeacon
• Filter and sort - focus the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth lists on specific devices
Spectre requests location and other permissions only because Android gates these signals behind them.
Everything runs on-device, with no ads, trackers, analytics, or Google Play Services.
Network access is used only to probe devices on your own local network.

fdroid:eu.veldsoft.broker.name: Broker 1961
fdroid:eu.veldsoft.broker.summary: Very attractive board game which was created in 1961 for trading shares
fdroid:eu.veldsoft.broker.description:
Buy and sell stock shares. By play of Market Action cards, strategically manipulate prices to your advantage and to the downfall of your opponents. Win by having the most money in cash and stocks after the last card has been played. But be careful: if all of your remaining stock holdings crash, it is possible to be eliminated before the game is even over.
Originally published in 1961 as Broker by the Spencer-Murray Corporation of Swarthmore, Pennsylvania.
The original box is white, with lettering and logo in black, very basic, drab, and uninspiring. Yet this obscure title was quite a gem considering the limitation of games to choose from during its day.
In 1967 it was re-published by the German firm Otto Maier Verlag, which is the ancestor of Ravensburger Spieleverlag GmbH Verlag. Numerous re-publications followed (1972, 1977 and others) including at least one which gave the rules in German, English and Italian. It was also published in the Ravensburger Casino Series.
Components list for these editions are as follows: 160 stock certificates, 68 Market Action cards, 4 price markers, play money, stock price board.
The 1983 (9th edition) by Ravensburger Spieleverlag GmbH changes the title slightly to Börsenspiel instead of Das Börsenspiel and the original rules heavily. Although this set is well-designed and much nicer on the eyes, the bland original version featured larger (regular card deck) size action cards. An extra set of 18 "risk" cards replacing 18 market cards had been added and they act as event cards that immediately effect changes in the market. They cause the unfortunate player who draws one to play it instead of a market card, a chaotic effect that some players will not like. Android version was implemented by Martin Kostadinov. It is school project for finish 12 grade.

 is presented to you at once if you are too good memorizing, you can wipe ~/.var/app/me.sergiotarxz.JapaChar/config/.japachar/db.sqlite

 than the latin one.
 If you do not know any language based in latin script I cannot currently help you a lot with
 this app, sorry for that.
 Do you have old phones around? It is very possible that some of them are capable of running

fedora-packages:cpio/cpio.name: cpio

Archives are files which contain a collection of other files plus information about them, such as their file name, owner, timestamps, and access permissions. The archive can be another file on the disk, a magnetic tape, or a pipe. GNU cpio supports the following archive formats: binary, old ASCII, new ASCII, crc, HPUX binary, HPUX old ASCII, old tar and POSIX.1 tar. By default, cpio creates binary format archives, so that they are compatible with older cpio programs. When it is extracting files from archives, cpio automatically recognizes which kind of archive it is reading and can read archives created on machines with a different byte-order. Install cpio if you need a program to manage file archives.

FocusFlow rebuilds any web page around how you actually read. Swap in a typeface your eyes can decode, open up the spacing, put a guide under the line you're on, strip the page back to the words, have it read aloud, or ask for a plain-language summary — without leaving the page you're on.
Built for readers with dyslexia, ADHD, low vision or visual stress, and for anyone who reads a lot on screen.
NEW IN 2.13.0
• A fresh look across the popup, side panel and dashboard, in six themes that follow your device's light or dark mode until you choose one.
• A dashboard that shows how you read: words read, time saved, your streak and the aids you use — counted on your device.
• A Sites page to review, edit or delete each site's own settings, and to turn FocusFlow off on sites where you don't want it.
• Reader Mode: a Read aloud button in the top bar, and an AI tools button with every tool in one place (Pro).
• Reader Mode Insights: a free readability score and complex-word highlighting.
TYPOGRAPHY THAT FITS YOUR EYES
• Eight accessible typefaces, including the dyslexia-friendly OpenDyslexic. All bundled with the extension, so nothing is fetched from a font server.
• Control letter spacing, word spacing, line height, font size, weight and alignment.
• Font-only mode applies the typeface and leaves the site's layout alone — or switch Font changes off to keep the site's own typography while every other aid stays on.
• Bionic Reading bolds the leading part of each word to give your eye a fixation point.
• Syllable segmentation (Pro) breaks long words into their parts, by dots or alternating colour.
KEEP YOUR PLACE
• A reading ruler that tracks the line under your cursor.
• A focus line that dims everything outside a narrow reading window.
• Paragraph spotlight (Pro) dims the page except the paragraph you are on.
• Colour overlays for visual stress, plus contrast and saturation controls, a big cursor, link highlighting and reduce motion.
• Auto-scroll pace reader (Pro) keeps the page moving at your speed.
• Page Dark Mode (Pro): dark backgrounds on the pages you visit, or follow your device with System.
READER MODE
• Turn an article into a clean reading view — no ads, banners, sidebars or cookie walls.
• A clickable heading outline, a Read aloud button in the top bar, and Save to your Reading List.
• Insights: progress through the section, word and sentence counts, reading time, and a readability score from six standard formulas, with a switch that highlights complex words in the article. Free, and worked out on your device.

READ ALOUD
• Text-to-speech on any page using your browser's own voices, with voice, language and speed controls. Nothing you read is sent anywhere to be spoken.
• Immersion reading (Pro) adds a floating player, word and sentence highlighting, and auto-scroll that follows the voice.
AI READING TOOLS (PRO)
• Summarize — the gist of the page, or of the section you're reading in Reader Mode.
• Key points — a summary as a short list.
• Simplify — a dense passage in plainer words.
• Define — a word or phrase explained, then In this sentence for the meaning where you found it.
• Words to know — hard words explained before you read.
• Check my understanding — a few questions on what you read, each with the passage that answers it.
• Listen — have any AI answer read aloud.
• Available from Reader Mode, the toolbar popup, the side panel and the right-click menu.
FITS HOW YOU WORK
• Per-site settings — FocusFlow can be on everywhere, only where you want it, or tuned site by site. Review, edit or delete them on the dashboard's Sites page, and turn FocusFlow off on any site.
• Profiles — save a set of typography settings and switch between them. Three custom profiles free, unlimited on Pro.
• Reading List (free) and To-Do list (Pro), in the side panel and the dashboard.
• A dashboard with your reading statistics, AI credit balance, account, licence and help in one place.
• Keyboard shortcuts: Alt+Shift+D opens the popup, Alt+Shift+F turns FocusFlow off or on for the site, Alt+Shift+Up / Down change the size.
• Six themes and colour palettes, in 52 languages including Arabic, Hebrew and Persian (right to left).
WHAT'S FREE AND WHAT'S PRO
Free, and not time-limited: all eight typefaces, every typography control, the reading ruler, focus line, colour overlay, visual filters, big cursor, reduce motion, link highlighting, Bionic Reading, Reader Mode with Insights and readability, read-aloud with your system voices, per-site settings and the Sites page, three profiles, the Reading List, themes and the dashboard.
Pro adds: the AI tools (summarize, key points, simplify, define, Words to know, Check my understanding), Reader Mode PDF export, Page Dark Mode, immersion reading (floating player, word highlight, auto-scroll), syllable segmentation, paragraph spotlight, ruler and focus-area style presets, custom colours beyond the presets, per-site custom CSS, the auto-scroll pace reader, the To-Do list, unlimited profiles, and cross-device settings sync.
Pro is a licence from focusflowapp.in/pro .
PRIVACY
The reading tools run on your device and work offline. FocusFlow does not collect your browsing history, does not track you across sites, and uses no cookies, ads or analytics. Your reading statistics and feature usage are counted on your device.
Data leaves your browser only when you do something that needs it:
• AI tools (Pro) — the text you selected, or the page or the Reader Mode section you are reading when you ask for a summary or a quiz, is sent to our server, which passes it to a language-model provider. Define sends the text you select, and its sentence only if you choose In this sentence. Quiz answers are never sent.
• Licence activation (Pro) — your licence key, to our payment provider.
• Pro status (Pro) — your licence key, when you open the dashboard, to show your AI credit balance and subscription.
• Settings sync (Pro, opt-in, off by default) — your settings, per-site rules, the sites you excluded, Reading List, to-dos and reading statistics, stored in your FocusFlow account.
• Feedback form — what you type, with your extension version and browser.
Full policy: https://focusflowapp.in/privacy

firefox-addons:3119357.description:
Waysill tests the web page in your current tab against WCAG 2.2 AA. Every problem comes with what is wrong, who is affected and how to fix it, plus short code examples.
What gets checked
- Text, controls with too little colour contrast, measured as rendered, plus a suggested colour that passes
- Images, image links without useful alt text
- Form fields lacking a label; buttons, links lacking an accessible name
- Skipped heading levels, missing landmarks, no document language or title
- ARIA roles, states, properties that assistive technology cannot read
How to use
Click the toolbar button (or press Alt+Shift+K), then choose Check this page. Results are grouped by success criterion & impact. "Show on page" scrolls to an element, outlining it. A structure view lists headings plus landmark regions. Any issue can be copied as Markdown into a ticket. Runs are unlimited; no account needed.
Privacy
All checking happens locally in your browser. Waysill sends no site content, browsing history or usage data anywhere; there are no analytics. Tabs are read only after you click its button.
Pro: paid, $49 per year
We sell Pro licenses with Polar as merchant of record. One key also unlocks Waysill for VS Code. Pro adds:
- Site scan: up to 500 URLs of one site, found through its sitemap or its own links; permission for that single site is requested when you start
- Exports: CSV, JSON, printable report
- Saved runs that mark issues new, fixed or unchanged since your last scan
Activating Pro sends your license key to Polar for verification. Nothing else leaves your device.
Limits
Automated testing catches only some WCAG failures, so combine these results with keyboard plus screen reader testing. Waysill does not make a site compliant; pages are never changed. Frames from other origins stay untested.
Built on the open-source axe-core engine (MPL-2.0), with explanations written by us.

firefox-addons:2769625.name: tRPC Client Devtools
firefox-addons:2769625.summary: An unofficial tRPC devtools extension to inspect your queries, mutations and subscriptions
firefox-addons:2769625.description:
This is an unofficial tRPC client devtools extension that you can use to inspect queries, mutations and subscriptions from your tRPC app!
 In order to use it, you need to install the trpc-client-devtools-link npm package and add it to your tRPC client config (if you're using tRPC v10, install the @next version) 
The tRPC Client Devtools appear as a "tRPC" tab in your Firefox inspector when tRPC is detected, alongside other tabs like "Elements" and "Console". The devtools currently have 3 main features:
- Query inspector: View the input, result and elapsed time of the fired queries.
- Mutation inspector: View the input, result and elapsed time of the fired mutations.
- Subscription inspector: View the input, multiple results and their elapsed time of the subscriptions.
Code for this extension can be found at: https://github.com/rhenriquez28/trpc-client-devtools 
If you want to learn more about tRPC, check out: https://trpc.io/

firefox-addons:659372.name: Show my Password
firefox-addons:659372.summary: See what you type in every password field, and keep your passwords in a private encrypted vault with autofill, 2FA codes and a generator. Desktop and Android. Nothing ever leaves your device.
firefox-addons:659372.description:
Typed the password wrong again? Show my Password puts a small eye on every password field, so you can check what you typed. And now it can also remember your passwords for you, privately.
New in 2.1: a private password manager (optional)
- Encrypted vault on your device: AES-256-GCM, key derived from your master password with PBKDF2-SHA256, 600,000 iterations.
- Autofill only on the right site: look-alike domains are refused, and passwords are never filled on insecure pages.
- Offers to save new or changed passwords when you sign in.
- 2FA codes (TOTP), search, password history.
- Health check: finds weak and reused passwords.
- Auto-lock, encrypted backups, CSV import.
- No account, no server, no sync, no tracking: nothing ever leaves your device. Your master password is never stored.
See what you type
- An eye button on every password field: tap to show, tap again to hide.
- Works in embedded frames and in modern web components (Shadow DOM).
- Show or hide every password on the page at once: toolbar, right-click menu or Alt+Shift+P.
- Optional: hide again after 10, 30 or 60 seconds and when the form is sent.
Strong passwords in one tap
- Password generator (8 to 64 characters, no look-alike characters) and passphrase generator (EFF list of 7,776 words).
- Honest strength meter. Copy, or put it straight into the field.
Your choice: if you never create the vault, Show my Password works exactly as before.
Designed for touch screens on Firefox for Android. Interface in English and Italian.
Passphrase word list: EFF Large Wordlist (CC BY 3.0 US). Free and open source (MPL 2.0).
Project page: https://sourceforge.net/projects/displaypasswords/

firefox-addons:2779841.name: Brightness Slider Per Tab
firefox-addons:2779841.summary: Adjust brightness per tab. Minimal permissions. Low resource usage.
firefox-addons:2779841.description:
Adds a plain brightness slider menu popup icon.
 No background scripts using up resources.
*Few permissions needed.
The above two properties mean that page reloads and changes will clear the brightness. However, it can be immediately re-applied by either clicking the icon or by using the shortcut.
Shortcut: ctrl+shift+L (configure in about:addons -> gear icon -> "Manage Extension Shortcuts").
Use the shortcut, press tab to select the slider, then use left/right arrows to adjust brightness, and then escape to hide the slider. Page up/down can be used to change brightness with a higher step size.
For a more permanent brightness option, see https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dkameoka/brightness-addon/main/userContent.css

- Swap memory utilization
- Network utilization

fdroid:com.mesmerverse.weatherballoon.description:
A privacy-first, simplicity-first weather app. One screen: current conditions, the next 24 hours, the next 7 days.
 Named for the weather balloon, the humble instrument that gathers a forecast's raw truth and reports back, nothing more. On the home screen the current temperature wears a sun halo, flanked by two bright companion spots.
 Privacy 
 Weather and place search come from Open-Meteo: keyless, no account, no tracking. You can point the app at your own Open-Meteo server instead (HTTPS only).
 The radar card (US only) shows NOAA NEXRAD imagery from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet, fetched only while the card is open. Tile requests carry no coordinates, just which ~240 km map squares are in view. The base map is built into the app from public-domain Census and Natural Earth data and makes no requests at all.
 Only two permissions: INTERNET and ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION. Location is optional: pin a place by search and revoke it entirely.
 Coordinates are rounded to ~1 km before any request leaves the device.
 The town name in the header comes from the device's geocoder where one exists, sent the rounded coordinates only. Devices without a geocoder just show "My location".
 No Play Services, no analytics, no third-party SDKs. Networking is plain HttpURLConnection.
 The last good forecast is cached locally so the app works offline.
